name: Nestable Stockroom Roll-Cage Trolley
description: Original Singapore retail-stockroom-inspired display of two instances of the same empty roll cage. The tapered chassis are physically nested, with real grid openings, upright stowed decks, and separately grounded casters.
summary: Same original open cargo cage repeated in a true static nested pose, not a wider shopping trolley.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
creation_method: Individually modeled cage wires, tapered linked tubular frames, grounded casters and supported stowed platform, original Cycles studio render.
rights: Original project asset; redistribution terms for public downloads are not specified.
accuracy_notes: Interpretive static display; no real product, use instructions, load rating or handling performance. Blender -Y front/+Z up, glTF +Z front/+Y up.

attribution.credit: All modeled components, colors, floor graphic, and studio render are original.
